findings.comment: Tree proposed within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted electric equipment. Measurement from landscape plan shows tree at 4.3 feet lateral distance from transformer pad located west of Building 1. UCM § 1.10.10.4 requires minimum 10-foot clearance from pad-mounted equipment. Relocate tree to maintain 10-foot minimum clearance from transformer pad.

applicableAreas: southern property boundary near overhead electric line; western property boundary street yard area
findings.comment: Plant legend does not identify species of trees proposed near overhead and underground electric facilities. Sheet 31 (Landscape Plan) shows trees marked with generic symbols (M = Mitigation Tree, SY = Street Yard Tree, PL = Parking Lot Tree, P = Parking Buffer Point Tree) but includes no plant schedule identifying the species for trees shown in proximity to the OHE (overhead electric) line on the southern boundary or in the street yard area on the western boundary. Species identification appears only on Sheet 35 (Landscape Calculations), a separate document. Per standard practice and code requirements, species must be identifiable directly on the landscape plan to allow verification of utility-compatibility status, mature height classifications, and clearance zone compliance. Provide plant species identification on Sheet 31 landscape plan for all trees shown near electric facilities, including common name, scientific name, and mature height per ECM Appendix F.

Cannot verify if non-utility-compatible trees are proposed within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductor. Measurements indicate trees at approximately 0 feet (two trees) and 17.5 feet lateral distance from OHE line on southern boundary; however, species cannot be confirmed from available landscape plan documentation (see EL-2.10 deficiency). Utility-compatibility status per ECM Appendix F UC column cannot be verified without species identification on landscape plan. Once species are identified per EL-2.10 deficiency, verify all trees within 15 feet of conductor are marked as utility-compatible in ECM Appendix F.

Cannot verify if large trees (mature height 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) are proposed within 25 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductor. Measurements show trees at 0 feet, 0 feet, and 17.5 feet from OHE line on southern boundary; however, species and mature height cannot be determined from landscape plan (see EL-2.10 deficiency). Once species are identified, verify mature heights per ECM Appendix F and confirm that large trees (40+ feet) are either beyond 25 feet from conductor or are explicitly marked as utility-compatible with documented Austin Energy approval.

applicableAreas: southern property boundary; throughout landscape plan where electric facilities are present
findings.comment: Large trees (mature height 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) cannot be differentiated on landscape plan. Trees are shown only with generic category symbols (M, SY, PL, P) without indication of mature height or size category. Mature height information required to verify compliance with large tree clearance restrictions (EL-2.3) cannot be determined from the landscape plan. Once species are identified per EL-2.10 deficiency correction, differentiate trees on landscape plan to clearly mark those with ECM Appendix F mature height of 40+ feet near any overhead electric facilities.
